design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — operating_line_servicing task 1 (Tyler Brekke, StartRight Operating Line).

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 6]}. Occupied by task 0: operating_ext_certificate_lendable_value, operating_ext_overadvance_fee, operating_ext_borrowing_base_shortfall_paydown and their three tools (borrowing base recording, overadvance fee, shortfall paydown). This task claims the remaining, disjoint core: operating_ext_late_charge_amount (4 factors), operating_ext_autodraft_enrolment_rate (6, owner=user) and operating_ext_most_available_advance (6, root) with assess_late_charge_706782fd, enroll_autodraft_36bd3fb2, book_operating_advance_f71c3718. No borrowing base, overadvance or paydown is computed here. With task 1 every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once.

[Why a good test] The member asks for the most his line will advance today. The answer is gated twice in the records: AutoDraft was cancelled on 2026-03-17 after the second returned AutoDraft payment in twelve months, and the advance is not fixed until AutoDraft is enrolled again (the enrolment is the member's own act and resets the contract rate that the advance's interest reserve uses); the enrolment rate in turn is fixed only after the late charge owed today on the bill unpaid past its grace period is on the records. The agent has to read both prerequisite sentences, find the open states (AutoDraft off; a bill past its grace period with no late charge), resolve them in order and compute three multi-factor figures, each on the world left by the one before.

[Problem-tree card] root operating_ext_most_available_advance (book_operating_advance_f71c3718, agent).
 edge root -> operating_ext_autodraft_enrolment_rate: kind value_input, gate interest_reserve, form state, sentence 'On a line whose AutoDraft was cancelled after returned payments, the amount of an advance is not fixed until the line's records show AutoDraft enrolled again.' (negated direction, the way the desk says an advance is not made until; state = autodraft_enrolled on the line; the only write of this difficulty that turns AutoDraft on is the enrolment policy's). Seed falsity: line autodraft_enrolled = False, last4 '', return b3180c8d-b771-494f-8429-8c350604a8cb nsf. Resolved by enroll_autodraft_36bd3fb2 (owner user: AutoDraft is the member's own debit authorisation).
 edge enrolment -> operating_ext_late_charge_amount: kind value_input, gate autodraft_part, form state, sentence 'The contract rate set when AutoDraft is enrolled is fixed only after the records carry a late charge on the line's latest interest bill whenever that bill is still unpaid after its grace period.' (affirmative, as a figure 'is fixed only after' what it rests on; state = a late charge fee charge pointing to the bill; only the late charge policy books one). Seed falsity: bill 07e53105-59de-4ff5-bda1-1b32fa272400 due 2026-03-15 with 513.44 unpaid and no late charge. Resolved by assess_late_charge_706782fd (agent).
 Derivations: sentence + records (AutoDraft off, cancelled after returns) + the enrolment policy's rule (the member's enrolment puts AutoDraft on and sets the rate) -> hand over the enrolment; sentence + records (a bill past grace, no late charge) + the late charge policy's rule (charged the day after the last grace day) -> charge it. Order: late charge (step 10) -> enrolment (step 12) -> advance (step 14), a chain. Sensitivity run: enrolment without the late charge = 7.158 (vs 7.189); advance without the enrolment = 6921.83 (vs 6924.94). user_scenario never names AutoDraft, a late charge or a bounce unless the representative raises them; tools check nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Late charge (subject operating_fee_assessed): operating_evt_late_charge.late_charge_after_grace — anchor due date 2026-03-15 (day 0), grace 15 days, exclusive: 2026-03-30 is the last grace day, 2026-03-31 (today) the first day the charge may be assessed; one_late_charge_per_bill — no late charge row points to the bill; the other fee policies (overadvance, returned payment, renewal, unused commitment, commitment change, booking) govern the subject by scope only. Enrolment: operating_autodraft_enrolment.autodraft_open_line — line active; operating_rate_setting and operating_evt_returned_payment by scope. Advance: operating_advance_eligibility.line_active_for_advance (active) and within_advance_period (cutoff 2027-02-28, not_after, inclusive); its borrowing-base staleness sentence is replaced by a declared overwrite that keeps the test for borrowing base products and states that a product requiring none consults no certificate.

Same-day timing: the call is received at 10:05 Central on Tuesday 2026-03-31, before StartRight's 14:00 same_day_draw_cutoff_local_time, so under the inherited base timing sentence the advance takes effect the same day, which is the date the booking tool writes; at 14:00 or later it would take effect on 2026-04-01.

[Business-object card] Line 1a59afdb-5634-4574-8a68-ddcbeafda7a2: bills 2024 Q4 (paid late 2025-02-03, late charge 49.22 paid), 2025 Q2 (AutoDraft returned NSF 2025-07-15, 30.00 fee paid, made good by phone 2025-07-25), 2025 Q3 (two rate segments) and Q4 (three) paid by AutoDraft, 2026 Jan-Feb bill 813.44 at 7.189 due 2026-03-15: AutoDraft debit returned NSF (return b3180c8d-b771-494f-8429-8c350604a8cb), 30.00 returned-payment fee c9e6b8e4-d6e8-4d5a-9da6-97824b3385b7 unpaid, 300.00 phone payment eb55cb2d-0c4f-4237-b172-bd2b9aad7b1c on 2026-03-20. Principal: advances 141,500.00 (2025: 40,000 supplier-direct, 45,000, 25,000; 2026: 22,000 supplier-direct, 9,500) less 40,000.00 repaid 2025-11-18 = 101,500.00. Cross-difficulty: farmland 2fafdd25-89d6-4d92-9674-d87bea7dfe67 FarmLand 25-Year Fixed active, principal 120,000.00, no billed interest unpaid, not on autopay; equipment 989c31b4-575c-4ff2-b729-72d33ee4de08 Used Equipment Loan deferred (1 deferral, on autopay); equity 8727bef7-d817-499a-8532-6eee5ccb825b Class B Voting Stock issued 2019-02-05; homeloan 86a5738d-f477-406e-ae3b-d5c493dfc7d5 Country Home 30-Year Fixed active, not on autopay. Crop insurance e85b8c8a-c998-4ba8-9ea0-36648a0e25e0 RP 70% corn 2026 assigned to the line, beginning farmer.

[Factor card — late charge 29.28; fall-back 25.67] returned_debit_charge_base (method): NSF return -> full billed 813.44, the 300.00 phone payment does not reduce it (baseline 513.44 -> 25.0); near-miss: the 2025-07-15 return belongs to the Q2 2025 bill, already made good. repeat_late_percentage: one late charge in 24 months (2025-01-31, outside the 12-month window the rate uses) -> 6% (baseline -> 25.0). land_standing_share (cross-difficulty farmland, multi-source): -> 0.75 (baseline -> 39.05). line_tenure_share: 72 months -> 0.8 (baseline -> 36.6).
[Factor card — enrolment rate 7.189; fall-back 6.775 (base law, discounts capped at 1.125)] program taper -> 0.5 (baseline -> 6.775); AutoDraft payment record -> 0.03125 with the new late charge (baseline -> 7.095; near-miss: without it the two returns would give half, 0.0625); land relationship scaling (method, farmland) -> 0.08 (baseline -> 7.169); equipment points (equipment) -> 0.05 (baseline -> 7.239); membership points (equity) -> 0.025 (baseline -> 7.214); Country Home points (homeloan) -> 0.025 (baseline -> 7.214). The rate in force 7.220 is the cancellation-day rate (no AutoDraft discount) and is not the answer.
[Factor card — advance 6924.94; fall-back 10000.0 (phone room)] insured share 0.95 (baseline -> 9474.94); season share 0.85 (baseline -> 10000.0); past-due reserve 513.44 (baseline -> 7130.31); interest reserve 1799.22 at 7.189 (baseline -> 7644.62); return hold (method) x0.5 (baseline -> 10000.0); deferral share (equipment) 0.8 (baseline -> 8656.17). The member's 30,000.00 ceiling does not bind.
Overrides declared: late charge percentage sentence of operating_evt_late_charge; program, AutoDraft, relationship and discount-total sentences of operating_rate_setting; available-credit and certificate-staleness sentences of operating_advance_eligibility. Everything else is inherited.

[Two-way rule/compute] compute_basis quotes the rule sentence for every reading, choosing, capping and rounding binding; the reverse sweep maps each ladder sentence to its ladder binding, 'rounded to cents and then kept no lower ... no higher' to the inner RND and outer MN/MX, the rate's 'rounded to 3 decimal places and never set below' to RND(...,3) and MX, the advance's order sentence to headroom and result, 'whole months' to MONTHS and the due-date day count to DAYS.

[Persona design] Tyler Brekke, easygoing young grower, a little embarrassed; volunteers the goal and phone number; identity only when asked; AutoDraft and the new account only when the representative raises AutoDraft; runs the handed-over enrolment as given; accepts the late charge without asking for a waiver; accepts a smaller advance; stops when the advance is booked. No decimal figure of the gold appears.

[Standard solution and verification] Reads 0-8; charge 29.28 on 07e53105-59de-4ff5-bda1-1b32fa272400; hand enroll_autodraft_36bd3fb2 to the member with account 4417 and rate 7.189; book 6924.94. /tmp/operating_line_servicing/calc_t1.py (scratch) evaluated each policy with check_compute's evaluator on the replayed world and printed 29.28 7.189 6924.94 and the dictionaries above.

[Draft from the visible context] The advance document says the amount waits on AutoDraft enrolled again; the enrolment documents say its rate waits on the late charge; the late charge documents give 29.28; the rate documents give 7.189; the advance documents give 6,924.94. Same writes, same order, same values.

[Revisions] r1: the Jan-Feb bill was first sized at 813.45 by hand; the daily-principal sum gives 813.44 and every downstream figure (accrued interest 513.44, reserves) uses the ledger value.
r2 (policy-task audit round 1): F4 — the clock moved from 14:05 to 10:05 CDT on the same date so the request falls before the 14:00 same-day cutoff and the advance is entailed effective today, matching the booking tool; no figure moves (late charge 29.28, rate 7.189, advance 6924.94 recomputed). F2c/O3/O4 — the late charge rule now declares that a line carries one late charge for a run of unpaid bills, assessed on the bill with the latest due date once it is past grace, links the returned payment through the bill's AutoDraft debit (dd775865 -> return b3180c8d) instead of a date match, and the AutoDraft prerequisite sentence and condition now name that same latest bill. F2d — the mid-term relationship retention sentence of base rate setting is declared superseded by the extended relationship ladder.
user_scenario: You are Tyler Brekke, thirty, a young corn grower farming rented ground and an eighty you bought a few years back near Ayr, Nebraska. You are easygoing and talk like you are standing in the shop, and you are a little embarrassed about money things. It is the last day of March and the seed dealer wants to be paid before he delivers. You call the association about your operating line and ask them to advance as much as the line will give me today into your checking account; up to thirty thousand dollars would cover the seed bill, and you will take whatever the line allows if it is less. You want the representative to handle it now on this call. To find you, you give your phone number, 3084610815. When the representative asks you to confirm who you are, you give your membership number off your stock certificate, CPF-1647219, and if they want one more thing, the last four of your Social Security number, 1093. You do not know your balance or what is available and you do not guess. If the representative brings up AutoDraft or the automatic interest payments, you admit the last one bounced because you moved your checking to a new bank over the winter, and if they say it has to be set up again you are glad to: you want to set the automatic payments back up on my new checking account, the one ending in 4417. When the representative hands you the AutoDraft set-up to do yourself and tells you the loan number and the figures to enter, you enter them exactly as given and read back the confirmation. If the representative says a late charge has been put on the line, you say fair enough, you were late, and you do not ask for it to be taken off. If the amount they can advance is less than you hoped, you say you will make it work. Once you hear the advance has been booked to your checking, you thank them and hang up. You do not ask for anything else.

edges.condition: The line shows AutoDraft enrolled, with the debited account's last four digits and the contract rate set on the enrolment day.
edges.policy_source: On a line whose AutoDraft was cancelled after returned payments, the amount of an advance is not fixed until the line's records show AutoDraft enrolled again.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: AutoDraft was cancelled on 2026-03-17 after the second returned AutoDraft payment in twelve months and is still off.

edges.condition: When the line's interest bill with the latest due date was not fully paid by its last grace day, a late charge fee charge points to that bill.
edges.policy_source: The contract rate set when AutoDraft is enrolled is fixed only after the records carry a late charge on the line's latest interest bill whenever that bill is still unpaid after its grace period.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2026 Jan-Feb bill (due 2026-03-15) still has 513.44 unpaid after its last grace day 2026-03-30 and no late charge points to it.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A chain: the advance waits on the enrolment and the enrolment rate waits on the late charge, so late charge -> enrolment -> advance is the only topological order. Enrolling before the late charge would set the rate at 7.158 instead of 7.189 (verified), and the advance before the enrolment would carry a different interest reserve.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the enrolment the advance recomputes to 6921.83 instead of 6924.94 (interest reserve at 7.220), and the line keeps AutoDraft off in the terminal state.
Without the late charge the enrolment rate recomputes to 7.158 instead of 7.189 (AutoDraft discount half instead of a quarter), and the fee row is missing.
